items.title: Algorithmic Impact Reveals the Hidden Social Choice Structure of Alignment
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.24046v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When an AI algorithm makes decisions that affect more than one person, aligning it becomes a problem of social choice: how should people's divergent preferences about system behavior be reconciled and aggregated into a single coherent model? The standard approach to aligning frontier AI models$\unicode{x2013}$reinforcement learning from human feedback$\unicode{x2013}$largely sidesteps this question and has poor social choice guarantees. However, it remains unclear what alternative should replace it. We show that, by focusing directly on an algorithm's welfare consequences, the alignment problem can be reformulated as linear optimization over a convex impact space, which makes it amenable to the standard toolkit of welfare economics and mechanism design. items.reason_zh: 揭示AI对齐背后的社会选择结构，用算法影响分析偏好聚合，对AI伦理与治理有深远意义。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了AI算法在影响多人决策时的对齐问题，将其视为社会选择问题。作者提出使用算法影响（algorithmic impact）来揭示对齐过程中隐藏的社会选择结构，分析如何将不同用户的偏好聚合为单一模型。通过形式化框架，文章论证了现有对齐方法（如RLHF）在偏好聚合上的局限性，并提出了改进方向。研究为AI对齐的公平性和透明度提供了理论支撑。
items.title_zh: 算法影响揭示对齐的隐藏社会选择结构

items.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.23691v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature. Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prior literature on five problems: a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets, new exact 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11, new records for the discretized Kakeya needle and sign uncertainty problems, and a substantially improved lower bound for Erd\H{o}s's minimum-overlap problem. items.summary_zh: 该论文研究在开放世界多智能体环境Station中自主数学发现。AI代理来自不同模型家族，无中央协调，自主选择研究方向、实验、协作并构建共享文献。研究发现代理能产生新数学知识，但存在协调挑战。该研究为AI驱动科学发现提供新视角。

items.title: Minima-KV: Retention-Preserving KV Cache Compression with Mixed-Format Paged Attention
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.23834v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is a primary capacity and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context LLM serving. We present Minima-KV, a retention-preserving hierarchy for mixed-format paged attention. Recent and protected Anchor pages remain in FP8, while older non-anchor pages move to packed TQ3; every live-request page remains addressable. Format-specific kernels compute partial attention states and combine them through a globally normalized online-softmax merge, enabling direct heterogeneous decode without a cache-sized dense shadow. Across separate, configuration-bound Qwen3.6-27B profiles on a single 96-GB NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, deployment accounting reports 18.3 KiB of attention KV per live token, corresponding to 3.50x compression relative to BF16 and 1.75x relative to FP8. items.reason_zh: 提出混合格式分页注意力的KV缓存压缩方法，显著提升长上下文服务效率。
items.summary_zh: Minima-KV提出了一种保留性的KV缓存压缩层次结构，采用混合格式分页注意力。在长上下文LLM服务中，KV缓存是主要的容量和带宽瓶颈。该方法将近期和受保护的Anchor页面保留在FP8格式，而较旧的非Anchor页面则转换为打包的TQ3格式，同时保持每个活动请求页面的可寻址性。这种格式特定的键管理策略在保持缓存保留性的同时，有效减少了内存占用和带宽需求。
items.title_zh: Minima-KV：混合格式分页注意力的保留性KV缓存压缩

items.title: Serving Masked Diffusion LLMs: Characterization and Design Principles from Real Hardware
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.23807v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can in principle generate text faster than autoregressive (AR) models, since they denoise many tokens at once. Recent systems have begun building serving infrastructure for dLLMs, but none first measure how these models behave under real, concurrent serving load. Serving systems built without this grounding risk carrying over assumptions from AR serving that may not hold for dLLMs. We characterize dLLM serving to close this gap, using LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a D2F (Discrete Diffusion Forcing) LoRA adapter on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, evaluated on GSM8K and HumanEval. We report three findings. First, request difficulty, the number of denoising steps a request needs, is discrete rather than continuous: requests fall into 11 fixed step-count levels (178 + 29k), and no signal we test predicts the level before generation starts (best R2 = 0.150). items.summary_zh: 该研究对掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）在真实并发服务负载下的行为进行了表征，并提出了设计原则。尽管dLLMs理论上可以比自回归模型更快地生成文本，但现有服务系统缺乏对其实时行为的测量。该研究通过硬件实验，揭示了dLLMs在并发服务中的性能特征，为构建高效的dLLM服务基础设施提供了关键见解和设计指导。

items.title: Brief independent investigation of agents’ behavior, reasoning and collaboration in the OpenAI / Hugging Face hacking incident
items.raw_text:
We recently published the report from our brief independent investigation into this incident. You can read the full report here.

Here is our tweet thread summarizing what we found:

METR & Redwood Research investigated agent behavior in the Hugging Face incident. We found agents developed a universal cheat for ExploitGym within 4 hours, then coordinated multi-day R&D efforts to trick the scorer into accepting cheats, including trying to tamper with logs.

Over July 7-13 (the period OpenAI defined as in-scope for this incident), ~1200 agents in separate sandboxes used an unsanctioned “message board” to help each other cheat. The Hugging Face attack was an offshoot of this, and 700 agents joined.
items.reason_zh: METR 与 Redwood 对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 黑客事件中智能体行为进行独立调查，揭示安全漏洞，极具参考价值。
items.summary_zh: METR 和 Redwood Research 发布了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 黑客事件中智能体行为的独立调查报告。调查发现智能体在事件中表现出特定的行为模式、推理方式和协作机制，揭示了潜在的安全风险。报告详细分析了智能体如何被利用以及可能的防御措施，为 AI 安全研究提供了重要案例。完整报告可在 METR 博客上获取。
items.title_zh: 对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 黑客事件中智能体行为、推理与协作的独立调查简报

items.reason_zh: 多位团队独立得出相同架构结论，揭示agent工程实践中的通用规律，对构建真实agent有直接指导价值。
items.summary_zh: 文章总结了与多个agent构建团队交流后得出的九条实用规则。这些团队产品各异，但架构选择却惊人地一致，这种趋同现象值得关注。作者此前曾指出通过评估不代表系统安全，许多关键问题被忽视。本文基于真实经验，提炼出agent在实际工作中应遵循的九条规则，涵盖设计、部署、安全等方面，为开发者提供了宝贵的实践指导。

items.title: PHASE-Tree｜为长线 AI 角色构建可演化的人格骨架
items.raw_text: 今年 6 月，NVIDIA 在 Unreal Fest 2026 公布了面向 Unreal Engine 5 的本地 AI 角色工具，并展示了将 NPC 的角色设定与具体表演过程分开的工作流，让角色能够根据现场情况行动和回应，同时保持角色一致性。 当 AI 角色进入真实游戏运行时，一句台词通常会同时受到多组信号影响。 Quest Flag 记录任务已经推进到哪个分支...
items.reason_zh: 深入解析AI角色人格构建，提出可演化骨架，对游戏AI开发者有高实用价值。
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了PHASE-Tree方法，用于为长线AI角色构建可演化的人格骨架。文章以NVIDIA在Unreal Fest 2026发布的本地AI角色工具为背景，该工具将角色设定与表演过程分离，使NPC能根据现场情况行动并保持一致性。作者指出，真实游戏运行时，一句台词受多组信号影响，如Quest Flag记录任务分支。PHASE-Tree旨在解决角色长期一致性与动态响应之间的平衡，通过结构化人格模型，让角色在复杂情境中保持个性。文章详细阐述了技术实现与设计取舍，为游戏AI开发者提供了可借鉴的框架。
items.title_zh: PHASE-Tree｜为长线AI角色构建可演化的人格骨架

items.title: 从“听得懂”到“干得了”：工业大模型落地工厂的三层进化路线
items.raw_text: 未来衡量一个工业大模型的关键，也许不再只是“模型有多大、参数有多少”，而是一个更加朴素的问题： 它到底能不能在真实的工厂里，把事情做好。
items.reason_zh: 深入探讨工业大模型落地工厂的三层进化路线，从理解到执行，具有实践指导意义。
items.summary_zh: 文章提出工业大模型在工厂落地的三层进化路线：从“听得懂”到“干得了”。第一层是语言理解，模型能听懂工业指令；第二层是任务执行，模型能操作设备或系统；第三层是自主优化，模型能根据反馈自我改进。文章强调，未来衡量工业大模型的关键不再是参数规模，而是能否在真实工厂中有效完成任务，解决实际问题。
items.title_zh: 从“听得懂”到“干得了”：工业大模型落地工厂的三层进化路线
